• Register new projects and keep main information up to date.

users.description: On this page you can view all users registered to your projects and relevant information about them. Click "Manage" to see more details about the user.

Manage user creation and their profiles:
• Create invitations quickly and track who has joined.
• Adjust permissions according to each person's role.
• Keep profiles updated to ensure correct access to labelings and projects.

labelings.title: Labelings
labelings.description: On this page you can see statistics and respond to labelings you are part of.
labelings.tooltip:
Track all labelings you can respond to:
- See overall progress and pending items.
- Use filters to quickly find what needs to be done.
- Enter items to record answers safely and consistently.
labelings.onlyAdminsNote: You can view and respond to labelings you participate in, but only administrators can create new ones.

labelingsManage.title: Manage Labelings
labelingsManage.description: Manage and view labelings. Click 'New Labeling' to import a CSV and start configuration.
labelingsManage.tooltip:
Create labelings with the following flow:

1. Import CSV for column mapping.
2. Give the labeling a title, link it to an initial project, set start and end dates, and how many users need to label each item before finalizing.
3. Manage your new labeling by:
   • Creating a form using mapped columns as contexts, with questions related to each context and organized sections.
   • Assigning users to respond to the labeling.
   • Inspecting responses in a dashboard.
   • Exporting a CSV with responses from all users for each mapped row.
